scope: Read-only production backend, database, source, and prepared extension artifact compatibility; no browser run or database mutation in this check

backend.ancestry: Live SHA is an ancestor of remote main and includes f5c679ef08 (guest-owned organization) and ba1b4a696b (bounded, race-safe guest minting). No later remote-main changes touched the inspected guest authentication, guest organization, or run-entry source paths.

live_database.method: Supabase MCP read-only SQL on the project reported by both production health identities
live_database.signup_trigger_function: public._provision_new_user_organization calls iam.provision_signup_organization(new.id) without an anonymous-user skip

contract_compatibility.extension_fingerprint: The prepared source sends a stable 64-character SHA-256 hex X-Fingerprint-ID for guests; deployed aidream accepts 16-200 ASCII letters, digits, underscore, or hyphen.
contract_compatibility.guest_organization: The extension omits an organization for a fingerprint guest; the deployed funnel reads the guest's sole signup membership and installs that organization on the run.
contract_compatibility.verdict: Read-only source and live-service evidence supports the prepared 0.2.130 guest contract. The separate native acceptance receipts establish real guest answers; this report does not replace a fresh browser run.

reviewer_account.method: The receipt's 16-hex SHA-256 email fingerprint matched exactly one live auth.users email via read-only SQL; the matched user has no admin.admins row. No email or credential was selected or logged.
reviewer_account.browser_role_display: absent in the prior receipt; the read-only database check supplies the missing role evidence

limits: Production health and database checks are point-in-time; they do not promise future deployment or service availability.
This check does not prove ordinary-member organization permissions or account-to-guest UI state transition.
